summary.headline: Endpoint antivirus, Microsoft Tunnel, SQL Server support, and Remote Help planning updates define the week
summary.overview: The week combines refreshed Intune endpoint-security antivirus and Tunnel guidance with new Configuration Manager SQL Server support documentation and a Remote Help planning update.
summary.adminImpact: Endpoint, Tunnel, and Configuration Manager teams should review their operational runbooks and platform-support plans against the new guidance.

keyChanges.title: Endpoint-security antivirus guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft revised the Intune guide for managing antivirus settings with endpoint-security policies.

keyChanges.title: Supported SQL Server configurations guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft published Configuration Manager documentation for supported SQL Server configurations.

keyChanges.title: Microsoft Tunnel upgrade guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Intune Microsoft Tunnel upgrade documentation was revised.

summary.headline: Firewall and device-profile monitoring guidance is refreshed
summary.overview: The week contains updates to Intune firewall configuration and device-profile monitoring documentation.
summary.adminImpact: Review the current firewall and monitoring references before adjusting endpoint-security policy or investigating profile deployment.

keyChanges.title: Firewall guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft updated the Intune endpoint-security firewall documentation.

keyChanges.title: Device-profile monitoring guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Intune documentation for monitoring a device profile was revised.

summary.headline: May emphasizes custom compliance, remediation-agent upkeep, and Cloud PKI lifecycle planning
summary.overview: May updates Linux and Windows custom compliance, Security Copilot Vulnerability Remediation Agent material, endpoint security, and adds Cloud PKI certificate-authority renewal guidance.
summary.adminImpact: Use current compliance and agent documentation before policy changes, and incorporate Cloud PKI CA renewal into lifecycle planning.

keyChanges.title: Linux and Windows custom-compliance guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft revised custom compliance policies and settings guidance for Linux and Windows devices.

keyChanges.title: Cloud PKI certificate authority renewal guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft published documentation for renewing a certificate authority in Cloud PKI.

keyChanges.title: Vulnerability Remediation Agent setup guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Security Copilot Vulnerability Remediation Agent overview and setup guide was updated.

summary.headline: June combines cloud gateway lifecycle planning, STIG compliance, and Microsoft 365 packaging changes
summary.overview: June adds Cloud Management Gateway Windows Server image-deprecation and STIG audit-baseline guidance, plus a Microsoft 365 packaging announcement with Intune improvements and security features.
summary.adminImpact: Plan Cloud Management Gateway lifecycle work, assess STIG audit-baseline use, and review the packaging update for its security and Intune policy implications.

keyChanges.title: Cloud Management Gateway image-deprecation guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft published Windows Server 2022 image-deprecation information for Configuration Manager Cloud Management Gateway.

keyChanges.title: STIG audit-baseline compliance guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft added a guide for using STIG audit baselines to assess Windows device compliance in Intune.

keyChanges.title: Microsoft 365 Packaging Update is announced
keyChanges.detail: The mid-June to early-August update includes security capabilities, Intune improvements, and increased Exchange Online storage.

summary.headline: July centers on custom compliance, Configuration Manager privacy, and endpoint-management documentation
summary.overview: July refreshes custom compliance authoring, Configuration Manager security and privacy, Security Copilot agent management, and co-management Autopilot enrollment guidance.
summary.adminImpact: Review the current compliance and co-management references before policy or onboarding changes; security teams should verify agent-management procedures.

keyChanges.title: Custom compliance discovery-script guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft revised the guide for creating custom compliance discovery scripts.

keyChanges.title: Configuration Manager compliance privacy guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft updated security and privacy information for Configuration Manager compliance settings.

keyChanges.title: Vulnerability Remediation Agent management guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Security Copilot guide for managing the Vulnerability Remediation Agent was refreshed.
